$schema: FlowHRMS breakpoint tokens v1.0 — mobile-first, min-width queries only

intent.xs: Employee baseline. All employee flows must work fully at 360px.
intent.md: Tablet. Admin becomes usable: collapsed 72px sidebar, cards two-up, tables become scrollable with sticky first column.
intent.lg: Desktop admin baseline. Full 240px sidebar, full tables.
intent.xl: Wide admin. Three/four-up metrics, side detail panel instead of drawer.
intent.2xl: Content capped at layout.contentMaxWidth and centred.

rules: Never use max-width queries as the primary mechanism.
Bottom navigation is shown below md and hidden at md and above.
Sidebar is hidden below md (drawer on demand), collapsed at md, expanded at lg+.
Data tables must switch to the stacked employee-row card pattern below md.
